'''Qin Yazal'''<ref name="Join the Battle" /> was the [[Poletec]] [[chief]] of a [[Poletec village|village]] on [[Skako Minor]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Riding on the back of his [[keeradak]], he attacked [[Clone Force 99]]'s [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|ship]] and captured [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] in the mistaken belief that they had brought war to his [[planet]]. Clone Force 99 and [[Clone Captain|Captain]] [[Rex]] pursued him and helped explain his real enemy was [[Wat Tambor]], and that they had come to rescue their man [[Echo]]. The chief offered scouts to guide them to Echo's [[Purkoll|location]] after they promised they would leave afterwards.<ref name="A Distant Echo" />

However, they later returned to the village after being chased by the [[Techno Union]]'s [[droid]]s. Anakin managed to convince the Poletecs to fight with them, and, after the droids arrived, a [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|battle]] commenced. During the battle, the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[trooper]]s saved the chief's life multiple times, and together they fought off the droid [[army]]. After the battle, the chief said they would always have an ally on Skako Minor.<ref name="On the Wings of Keeradaks" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Qin Yazal was a Poletec male chief, who was 2.6 [[meter]]s (8 [[Foot|feet]], 6 inches) tall.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Skills and abilities==
As the leader of his Poletec village, Yazal was skilled in armed and unarmed combat, military tactics and [[keeradak]] handling.<ref name="Join the Battle" />
